name: inspect_il2cpp_metadata
description: Inspect local Unity IL2CPP metadata (24/27/29/31/39), optionally linking a caller-selected 64-bit little-endian Mach-O, PE or ELF binary. Static reading only. Default summary retains complete Evidence; use parent_evidence_id with inspect_analysis_view kind il2cpp-metadata for named collections, indices, fields and paging. Parameters accept method_indices; method_addresses accept addresses and states. Stable row indices are scoped to the metadata digest; native pages also identify the binary. Native states distinguish executable code, observed zero slots (no-body), and unknown owners/relocations. Shared addresses preserve all methods. code_gen_modules pages accept image_indices; summaries omit that table. Type names are C#-like; version27 retains indices with unknown names. Unrequested native counts are null. Static-table links are derived; the x86-64 executable-byte fallback is inferred and does not verify instruction boundaries. Input guards:256MiB metadata/1GiB binary;64MiB encoded report; one active inspection. Unsupported layouts, pointer encodings and resource limits have typed reasons. Full Evidence remains available with detail complete. Neither static linking nor structural agreement proves runtime behavior or a same-build pair.

binary_architecture.description: Slice to read from a universal Mach-O binary_path; required for universal binaries and rejected otherwise

binary_path.description: Absolute path to the caller-selected matching 64-bit IL2CPP binary (Mach-O GameAssembly.dylib, PE GameAssembly.dll or ELF libil2cpp.so); static reading, never executed

detail.description: summary (default) retains complete Evidence and returns identity and collection counts; complete returns every image, type, method, member, parameter and string-literal row inline

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to a Unity IL2CPP global-metadata.dat file
